root_cause: The while loop condition `takaHeight > plantHeight` does not handle the case where `takaHeight` is exactly equal to `plantHeight`. This may lead to incorrect results or an infinite loop scenario.
suggestion:
Suggestion 1. Adjust the loop condition Adjust the while loop condition to handle the case where `takaHeight` is exactly equal to `plantHeight`. Change the condition from `takaHeight > plantHeight` to `takaHeight >= plantHeight`. This ensures that the loop exits correctly even when `takaHeight` and `plantHeight` are equal.

1. Locate the while loop in the `main` method.
2. Change the line from:
```java
while (takaHeight > plantHeight) {
```
to:
```java
while (takaHeight >= plantHeight) {
```
This fix will ensure the loop will not continue endlessly and will terminate correctly when `takaHeight` is equal to `plantHeight`.
